title: Zesty slow cooked Canadian smoked meat Hash
description: A spicy and flavorful Canadian dish featuring slow-cooked smoked meat, perfect for a brunch mood, made with oil and kosher-friendly ingredients. This dish is sure to satisfy your cravings.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the diced potatoes with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are slightly tender.
While the potatoes are roasting, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are softened and lightly browned, about 10 minutes.
Add the sliced bell peppers to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked meat to the skillet, stirring to break it up with the onions and bell peppers, and cook until it is heated through.
Add the roasted potatoes to the skillet and stir to combine with the smoked meat mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the hash, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together.
